comment: Existing painted texts that match scripts/trademark-denylist.json, recorded verbatim (file + text) with a reason.
User decision 2026-09-10: the strings already on the textures stay ('F1 LIVE', 'MOBILITY RESORT', 'ROUND 17',
the garage team names). Only strings not listed here fail scripts/textures-lint.mjs. Data-driven text — the
garage panels paint `team.name` from app/data/drivers.ts through a variable, not a literal — is out of the
lint's scope by construction (templates with interpolation and identifiers are never scanned).
'SUZUKA CIRCUIT' in a plain typeface is a place name and is not on the denylist.
